sample_unit: NCCT scans (retrospective, four centers); plus 13,399 patients in prospective application

links.outcome: Physician ASPECTS diagnostic AUC and reading time with versus without the AI system
links.effect: Combining the system with physicians improved AUC from 67.43% to 89.76% and reduced diagnosis time from 130.6 ± 66.3 s to 33.3 ± 8.3 s (p < 0.001).
links.quote: Combining the system with physicians improved AUC from 67.43 to 89.76%, reducing diagnosis time from 130.6 ± 66.3 s to 33.3 ± 8.3 s (p < 0.001).

screen.reason: Evaluates an automated ASPECTS deep learning system in both reader studies (physician alone vs with AI assistance) and a prospective real-world clinical deployment measuring adoption and workflow efficiency.
